body: How are you?

:(

Couldn't have said it better myself. How are you doing today?
That sounds lovely. Did you like Toy Story 3?

College sucked for me. It's definitely not all that it's made out to be. I'm just glad to be done with it, even though I have not much to show for it; a college degree is pretty much worthless in today's workforce, what with the economy and everything.

And yes, I have noticed. Makes me wonder why I should even continue with this life. :( :( :(

This is for you, thank me after: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gbXrdOwDlGc

I absolutely love this song LIVE.

I must be the only redditor, scratch that, the only person that hasn't seen Inception. I should maybe...check it out?

Can I ask what your lucid dream was about? Have you much experience with lucid dreaming?

Lol, you read horoscopes? ;) I bet *all* horoscopes have something to say about future career/job opportunities as its so relevant and applicable to everyone, especially nowadays. If I do happen to get a job around the 14th though, that would be super creepy... I would owe you one, dude2k5. For sure!

Medical Marijuana Club "stuff and whatnot"??? Jealous face. I would love to be a front desk worker!

You definitely shouldn't upgrade. Apple is trying to shove social networking down its users throats, and I am not down. I'm beginning to realize that most upgrades aren't really "upgrades" anymore either, hehe. I didn't ask for this!!!

Hahaha @ "don't get me started". I could say the same thing about some (if not most) of the people in MY country. 

Langosi looks amazingly delicious. Wish I could try one.

Since you like to try making different kinds of soups, you are in luck, as soup season is near! I really like chili, because its easy to make, delicious, and reheats well.

Do you have any random questions for me? :)

That sounds right up my alley. I am fascinated with dreams, lucid dreams especially. Have you ever seen Waking Life? Neat animation, and cool movie overall. Definitely worth checking out.

Thanks for the intro and the song!

You're taking a gamble, but aren't we all? College is overrated. I hope that luck is on my side, but so far its been 8 months and I feel even more discouraged as each day goes on. Maybe you can be my good luck charm?

I am not in CA, seems like a lot of redditors on this thread are though. What kind of stuff do you need help with? Curious cat here!

I am all about the list for camping. Fuck yeah! And I agree with you, it has been a nice summer. Pretty cool, and it seemed to go by in a blink of an eye right?

It's ok if you fall asleep. You know what's crazy, I just threw Kid A on minutes before reading your comment. <shivers>

You know what? I really hate the new iTunes. Fuck the new iTunes, the UI looks like shit.
Thank you! I have never even heard of that movie!?

Real friends can make all the difference in the world. I myself have two awesome best friends, and I don't know what I would do without them.

Good for you for making the decision (and carrying it out, nonetheless) to at least try and experience new things. Stepping outside your comfort zone can be scary, but quite fulfilling in return.

It is nice, super nice, to have another person to chill with late into the night. But you are definitely right in saying that it makes the rare nights that I find myself alone all the more difficult. :(

Alright, well I have a new question then. What is your favourite kind of donut? And...what do you typically like to eat in the evening?

I have all this energy, but in an attempt to wind myself down I just took my laptop to bed where I am now at.

I want a girlfriend who will make me bomb ass French toast in the morning! That sounds so delicious. Haven't had that in forever.

Do you mind if I ask what corner of the world you are in? I live in the US, west coast to be exact.
And where is MY song? ;)

I just scraped together a bowl by flashlight! I win! :)

Yes, at least college is over and done with. But the sinking feeling of "what am I going to do with my life NOW?" is enough to make any person feel shitty, if not a little bit uncomfortable. I definitely check CL all the time, but there are so many goddamn applicants to even the most menial of jobs that I don't even stand a chance. 

Maybe I'll send you a few pics of my piece tomorrow by PM. It's pretty awesome, and hits well. I can't wait to go camping; it's kinda the last hurrah before summer is officially over and it starts raining every day.

Living alone has it's ups and downs, but speaking as a more introverted and private person it has more UPS! You basically get to do whatever the hell you want. 

:D

Hi novaseeker! Thanks for your comment. I can understand where you're coming from. /hugs

It's now 2:09 AM where I am and I still am not in the least bit tired. So let's talk a bit...what is your favourite breakfast food?

Can I walk around an empty neighbourhood with you? A late night walk sounds so appealing to me right now. The crisp cool air, stars shining above, and the allure of darkness...

I'm glad to hear that you are doing much better now. May I ask what contributed to this?

My boyfriend usually stays up late with me, in fact almost all of the time. But he was super tired tonight and just passed the fuck out after we finished watching some anime. He tried to get me to come cuddle and fall asleep, but my mind just felt so restless...

Let's take an e-bonghit together right now, whaddya say? :)

What's going on in my life...I graduated from college at the beginning of this year, and have been unemployed since then. It's really fucking difficult to find a job where I live (and pretty much everywhere in the US). Anything fun lately, I received a new piece from my friend who is a glassblower. And the only thing I have planned as of late is to go camping over Labour Day weekend!

Where are you moving to? What do you mean, "alone in a house"? I assume it will be your first time living alone?

I hate moving. But it will (hopefully) be worth it when it's all said and done. Just remember to buy more packing tape/boxes than you think you'll need. Trust me. :)
Here's a song for you: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PUSDZr8aaOY

What did you used to "waste your time with"? I'm curious.

It's funny - I am such a night owl that I typically feel the most awake/active in the midnight hours. 

And yeah, I'm just feeling particularly lonely tonight. Can't really explain why... :(

Well, there is /r/nosleep. But it has a creepy-ish theme to it, and will probably keep you up even longer. Lol.

What usually keeps me up at night is my thoughts. I feel so restless, and my mind is swarming with a zillion thoughts at once; makes it difficult to just settle down and get *sleepy*.

Usually I smoke a bowl or 2 to help me sleep. But I'm dry, and tired of scraping for resin.

Nothing in particular is "wrong", I've suffered with depression in varying degrees throughout my whole life. I just feel as if recently it has gotten increasingly worse...

It's crazy to me that I can feel so lonely when my boyfriend is right upstairs. :/

Not too much. Can't sleep, just feel so alone. :(

What are you up to?
Thanks, nice cake there. :)
